turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.replyText:
Hi Nora, I’m Nova AI, Fashion Nova’s AI customer care assistant. I’m not a human.

It looks like there aren’t any orders showing on this account yet. If you placed it a few days ago, it may be under a different email or as a guest checkout, can you share the order number (or the 9-character confirmation code from the checkout page) so I can pull up the tracking?

turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyText: Standard orders can take up to 4 business days to process before they ship. Once a tracking number is issued, the first carrier scan can take a couple of days to show up. For shipping timeframes by method, see [Shipping Options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options).

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyText:
It depends on the shipping method you choose at checkout:

- **Standard Shipping:** 3–7 business days  
- **2 Business Days (order by 3pm ET):** 2 business days  
- **1 Business Day (order by 3pm ET):** 1 business day  

Business days don’t include weekends or US holidays. Full details are on our [Shipping Options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options) page.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyText:
After checkout, the shipping method can’t be changed.

If you haven’t placed the order yet, you can choose an expedited option at checkout (1 Business Day or 2 Business Days, if available for your address).

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyText:
If tracking never updates, it usually means either the carrier hasn’t done the first scan yet, or the order is still processing.

If it’s past the delivery estimate you were given at checkout and tracking still hasn’t moved, message us back and I can investigate further. You can also check status anytime on our [Track Order page](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/track-order).

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyText:
If it’s already shipped and with the carrier, Fashion Nova can’t change the delivery address.

If you share the order number, I can check whether it’s shipped yet.
